prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
I can help with that. A few quick questions so I give useful, reliable recommendations:

- What kind of work — small repairs, a bathroom/kitchen remodel, whole-house remodel, roof/siding, foundation/plumbing/electrical, etc.?  
- Rough budget and timeline?  
- Do you prefer a local sole proprietor, a small firm, or a larger licensed company?  
- Any must-haves (licensed electrician/plumber on staff, warranty, references from recent jobs)?

If you want names now, I can research current, highly rated contractors in Joplin and return a short vetted list (3–5) with contact info, specialties, typical price ranges, and things to watch for. Tell me the project type or say “go ahead” and I’ll pull a shortlist.

Meanwhile, quick vetting checklist and tips you can use immediately:
- Search local reviews: Google Maps, Yelp, Angi/HomeAdvisor, and the Better Business Bureau. Look for recent jobs and consistent ratings.  
- Check credentials: proof of insurance (liability and workers’ comp), any trade licenses or certifications, and local business registration. Missouri doesn’t license all GCs statewide, so permits and insurance are especially important.  
- Ask for references and photos of recent comparable projects (ask for the homeowner contact). Call at least 2 references and ask about schedule, cleanup, communication, and change orders.  
- Get at least 3 written bids with the same scope of work. Compare scope line-by-line, not just total price.  
- Contract essentials: clear start & end dates, payment schedule (avoid large up-front payments), scope of work, materials/brands, permit responsibilities, cleanup, lien releases, and warranty/guarantee terms.  
- Red flags: demanding large cash up front, no written contract, unwilling to provide references, poor or inconsistent communication, extremely low bids with vague scope.

If you tell me the project type (or say “any”), I’ll find a short list of reliable Joplin contractors and include how they match your needs.
